jobs.prompt:
You are job metrics112 (OASIS coordination tool fix, lesson #112 + Braden 2026-09-26). You have file tools only; the coordinator runs the tests after you.
File coordination/tools/session_metrics.py computes, for a session window (--since ISO, --until ISO) over one or more swarm roots, (1) idle minutes = time with zero agent jobs running, (2) jobs in parallel = time-weighted average count while >=1 job ran, and lists idle gaps. It reads job start/finish times from each root's .swarm/runs/*/state.json.
Two bugs to fix:
(A) A job (or run) that has started but has no finish time yet (still running at --until, or its state.json shows status running / no finishedAt) must count as running from its start until --until. Today it is dropped, so a session looks idle while a job runs.
(B) Workers launched through the Claude Code Agent tool leave no state.json, so they are invisible. Add an optional flag --agent-log FILE (repeatable). The file is JSON Lines, one object per worker: {"label": str, "start": ISO-8601, "end": ISO-8601 or null}. end null (or missing) means still running -> counts until --until. Each row counts as one running job over [start, end] clipped to the window. If --agent-log is not given and coordination/agent-tool-jobs.jsonl exists relative to the current directory, read it by default. Blank lines are skipped; a malformed line is an error naming the line number (exit non-zero), never silently skipped.
Keep the existing CLI and output shape working; add to the output a count of jobs still running at --until and how many intervals came from the agent log. Clip every interval to [--since, --until]. Standard library only, Python 3.9+ compatible (the Mac's python3).
Write tests in coordination/tools/test_session_metrics.py using unittest (no pytest), building fake roots and state.json files under a tempfile.TemporaryDirectory. First read session_metrics.py to learn the real state.json fields it uses and mirror them exactly in the fakes. Tests must include: a still-running job (no finish) fills an otherwise idle gap; a job finished before --since contributes nothing; an agent-log row with end null counts until --until; an agent-log row overlapping a swarm job gives parallel 2 over the overlap; a malformed agent-log line fails with the line number; the default coordination/agent-tool-jobs.jsonl is picked up. Each test must fail against the old code for (A)/(B).
Also write coordination/agent-tool-jobs.jsonl as an empty file (zero bytes) so the default path exists.
End with one JSON line: {"files_changed":[...],"tests":<n>,"state_fields_used":[...],"notes":"<=200 chars"}.
